data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘av’ meaning ‘father’, and ‘rah’ meaning ‘exalted’ or ‘multitude’. In the Bible, Abraham is the father of the Jewish people and is known for his faith and obedience to God. The name Abrahan carries the meaning “Father of a multitude” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abrahan usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.
